title: Prevention of Acquisition of HIV: Preexposure Prophylaxis for adolescents and adults at increased risk of HIV

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians prescribe preexposure prophylaxis using effective antiretroviral therapy to persons who are at increased risk of HIV acquisition to decrease the risk of acquiring HIV.

action: Prescribe preexposure prophylaxis (PrEP) using effective antiretroviral therapy

uncomputable.needs: HIV acquisition risk assessment (sexual behavior, injection drug use, partner HIV status, clinician judgment)

denominator.quote: persons who are at increased risk of HIV acquisition

uncomputable.needs: record of PrEP prescription with effective antiretroviral therapy (grammar has no medication/prescription criterion type)

numerator.quote: prescribe preexposure prophylaxis using effective antiretroviral therapy
